titanic: Survived: 0 = did not survive, 1 = survived. Pclass: ticket class, 1 = first, 2 = second, 3 = third. Sex: female or male. Age: age in years (some missing). SibSp: number of siblings or spouses aboard. Parch: number of parents or children aboard. Fare: ticket fare. Embarked: port of embarkation, C = Cherbourg, Q = Queenstown, S = Southampton.
bike: One row per day, 2011-2012 (Capital Bikeshare, Washington D.C.). dteday: date (YYYY-MM-DD). season: 1 = spring, 2 = summer, 3 = fall, 4 = winter. yr: 0 = 2011, 1 = 2012. mnth: month 1-12. holiday: 1 if the day is a holiday, else 0. weekday: day of the week, 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ..., 6 = Saturday. workingday: 1 if the day is neither a weekend nor a holiday, else 0. weathersit: 1 = clear or partly cloudy, 2 = mist or cloudy, 3 = light snow or light rain, 4 = heavy rain or snow. temp: normalized temperature (Celsius / 41). atemp: normalized feeling temperature (Celsius / 50). hum: normalized humidity (divided by 100). windspeed: normalized wind speed (divided by 67). casual: rentals by casual users. registered: rentals by registered users. cnt: total rentals (casual + registered).
